items.html: It is known that Ehyeh spelled with Yudin is in the upper Bina, for Tevuna is called by the name SAG. Therefore this Tzal, with its two letters, is numerically equal to the spelling of Ehyeh spelled with Alephin, and numerically equal to ‘in the shadow of Shaddai.’ It lacks the Ehyeh itself, and only its spelling remains in it, as mentioned above, for the Name Ehyeh itself is in Bina and not in Tevuna.
